highlights: High-Quality Audio: Baseus Encok HZ20  wired earphones offer an unparalleled music experience with leading audio technology, ensuring every note is delivered with great detail and quality.
Sophisticated Design: Featuring a sophisticated design, these earphones provide both style and functionality for an exceptional listening experience..
Versatile Music Enjoyment: Whether you enjoy vibrant pop, soothing classical tunes, or experiential game audio, the Baseus Encok HZ20  ensures an ideal audio experience for every genre.

Ergonomic Comfort: The ergonomic design of the earphones ensures a perfect fit, providing maximum comfort during long music-listening sessions. Concentrate on the music without discomfort or headaches.
Built-in Controls: Easily pause/play music, and make phone calls using the controls on the headphone cord, offering convenience without taking your phone out of your pocket.

Solid Build Quality: Built with premium materials, the Baseus Encok HZ20 wired earphones guarantee long-term durability and reliability, making them your loyal companion for every journey and music session.

Wide Compatibility: Compatible with a variety of devices, including  Samsung Galaxy devices, Google Pixel, OnePlus, and more with a USB-C audio port. Also compatible with devices having USB-C audio settings.
Mac Settings: For optimal audio, adjust settings on Mac by navigating to System Preferences > Sound > Output (Input) and selecting the Baseus Encok HZ20 as the preferred audio device.
Ultimate Music and Convenience: Experience the perfect combination of quality audio and stylish design with Baseus Encok HZ20 wired earphones ensuring ultimate music enjoyment and convenience.
